WSH.detail: The Commanders placed McNichols (foot) on injured reserve Tuesday.

WSH.name: Jer'Zhan Newton
WSH.detail: Newton (pectoral) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Eagles.

WSH.name: Terry McLaurin
WSH.detail: McLaurin (knee) underwent surgery Friday to repair the torn patellar tendon in his left knee, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

WSH.name: Laremy Tunsil
WSH.detail: Tunsil (triceps) could potentially return late in the season, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

WSH.name: Jaylin Lane
WSH.detail: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

WSH.name: Drew Stevens
WSH.detail: Stevens made four of his five field-goal attempts and converted his only extra-point try during Sunday's 27-10 win versus the Eagles.

WSH.name: Chig Okonkwo
WSH.detail: Okonkwo tallied two catches (on four targets) for 32 yards during Sunday's 27-10 win versus the Eagles.

WSH.name: Treylon Burks
WSH.detail: Burks (foot) caught three of five targets for 81 yards in Sunday's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

WSH.name: Antonio Williams
WSH.detail: Williams caught five of seven targets for 54 yards during Sunday night's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

WSH.name: Austin Ekeler
WSH.detail: Ekeler rushed eight times for 36 yards in Sunday night's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

WSH.name: Rachaad White
WSH.detail: White rushed 11 times for 55 yards and a touchdown while catching two of three targets for five yards in Sunday's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

WSH.name: Stefon Diggs
WSH.detail: Diggs caught three of six targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-10 win over the Eagles.

WSH.name: Jayden Daniels
WSH.detail: Daniels completed 16 of 29 passes for 217 yards and a touchdown while rushing twice for 23 yards in Sunday's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

WSH.name: Charles Omenihu
WSH.detail: Omenihu (groin/ankle) is active for Sunday night's contest against the Eagles.

WSH.name: Athan Kaliakmanis
WSH.detail: Kaliakmanis (coach's decision) is inactive but serving as the Commanders' emergency third quarterback Sunday night against the Eagles.

WSH.name: John Bates
WSH.detail: Bates (shoulder) is active for Sunday night's matchup with the Eagles.

WSH.name: Van Jefferson
WSH.detail: The Commanders signed Jefferson to the active roster Wednesday, Zach Selby of the team's official site reports.

WSH.name: Marcus Mariota
WSH.detail: Mariota (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

WSH.name: Sonny Styles
WSH.detail: Styles finished Monday's 23-17 loss to the 49ers with 13 tackles (seven solo) and one pass defense.
